sections.offseason:
**Rams (30.5 PPG in 2025, MVP Stafford 4,707 yds/46 TD).** Traded Verse + 2027 1st + 2028 2nd for Myles Garrett; traded pick 29 + 3 picks for CB Trent McDuffie; signed CB Jaylen Watson, S Kam Curl; Aaron Donald unretired. Stafford 1-yr/$55M extension. Drafted QB Ty Simpson (13), TE Max Klare (61). Lost RT Havenstein (retired), five CBs. Kingsbury added as asst. HC. Nacua in contract year.
**49ers (12-5).** DC Saleh left for Titans HC; Raheem Morris now DC. Signed WR Mike Evans (3/$60.4M), WR Christian Kirk, Deebo Samuel (1-yr), LB Greenlaw, CB Nate Hobbs; traded a 3rd for DT Osa Odighizuwa. Lost Jauan Jennings, Bourne, Huff. Drafted WR De'Zhaun Stribling (33). QB Purdy (9 games in 2025, 20 TD/10 INT).
sections.matchup:
**Rams O vs SF D:** Nacua 36% target rate, 129-1,715-11. Adams 51.9% of Rams end-zone targets (league-high), 14 TD in 14 games. Stafford 2+ TD in 15/17. Rams led NFL with 76 RZ trips, 63.2% TD rate, +141 RZ plus/minus (1st). Kyren Williams 259-1,252-10 + 3 rec TD; Corum 145-746-6 with 25 carries inside the 20 (5 TD). SF D: 13th in points allowed, 24th vs run, allowed 8.36 yds/target to WRs (5th-most); DT depth gutted (Collins, Okuayinonu, Mykel Williams out).
**49ers O vs LAR D:** McCaffrey 311-1,202-17 rush + 102-924-7 rec (23.3% target share). SF ran for 2.55 YPC vs LAR in 2025. Kittle 7 TD in 11 games. SF +99 RZ plus/minus (2nd). LAR D: 19.9 PPG allowed (7th), 7th vs run, 38% pressure (5th); allowed 38.2 rec yds/g to RBs (5th-most).
sections.injuries:
**SF:** OUT DT Alfred Collins (patellar tendon, season), DE Okuayinonu (IR), DE Mykel Williams (PUP). Q DT James Thompson. Bosa, Kittle, Greenlaw, Evans active.
**LAR:** OUT DT Aaron Donald (did not travel, conditioning). Garrett full. CB Watson (toe) limited.

sections.offseason:
**Steelers:** Tomlin stepped down; Mike McCarthy HC (Jan 27). OC Brian Angelichio, DC Patrick Graham. Rodgers (42) back for final season. Traded for WR Michael Pittman Jr.; traded Pickens to DAL. FA: CB Jamel Dean, RB Rico Dowdle, DT Joseph-Day, S Brisker. Draft: OT Iheanachor (21), WR Germie Bernard (R2), QB Drew Allar (R3). Depth: Warren > Dowdle > K. Johnson; Freiermuth > D. Washington.
**Falcons:** Fired Morris/Fontenot; HC Kevin Stefanski, GM Cunningham, OC Tommy Rees, DC Ulbrich retained, OL coach Callahan (run-first). Released Cousins, Mooney; signed QB Tua Tagovailoa (Week 1 starter; Penix not ready post-knee), RB Brian Robinson Jr., WR Dotson. Pitts extended (3y/$54M). No R1; drafted CB Terrell (48), WR Zachariah Branch (79).
sections.matchup:

**PIT O vs ATL D:** Rodgers 22nd EPA/play; McCarthy passes in RZ (57.9% inside the 10 with DAL 2024). Metcalf 6 rec TD, 11 end-zone targets; Freiermuth 4 TD, 8 inside-20 targets. ATL D: 57 sacks (2nd), 19 pass TD allowed, 4.6 YPC allowed, 59.4% single-high. Edge gutted: Jalon Walker (ACL), James Pearce Jr. (8-game susp.), Z. Smith/Dorlus limited.

**ATL:** Penix inactive; LIMITED CB Bowman (Q), WR Branch, DL Dorlus, DE Z. Smith, OL Hinton. OUT Pearce (susp.), Walker (ACL).

sections.offseason:
**Ravens:** Harbaugh fired; Jesse Minter HC (Weaver DC, Declan Doyle OC). Signed EDGE Trey Hendrickson (4yr/$112M) after rescinded Crosby trade. Lost C Linderbaum (LV), TEs Likely (NYG) and Kolar (LAC), EDGE Dre'Mont Jones, S Gilman, RB Keaton Mitchell. Draft: G Vega Ioane (14), OLB Zion Young, WR Ja'Kobi Lane. Rookie-level C Jovaughn Gwyn starts. Lamar Jackson QB. 2025: 8-9, 30th vs pass, 10th vs run.
**Colts:** Steichen/Ballard retained; Lou Anarumo DC. Daniel Jones re-signed (2yr/$88M) after Nov Achilles tear; Pierce extended. Traded WR Pittman (PIT) and LB Zaire Franklin (to BAL). Signed WR Keenan Allen, EDGE Arden Key, DT Nnadi, CB Taylor-Britt. Lost RT Braden Smith, Kwity Paye, S Nick Cross. No 1st-rounder. 2025: 8-9, lost final 7 after Jones injury.

**IND O vs BAL D:** With Jones, IND scored 27.4 ppg (8th), 57.6% RZ TD rate. Taylor: 20 total TD (led NFL), 19 carries inside the 5 (2nd), scored in 6 of 8 home games. Warren: team-high 112 targets, 26 RZ targets, 5.8 xTD vs 4 actual. BAL D 30th vs pass, 31st sack rate before Hendrickson.

**IND limited:** WR Alec Pierce (heel, on track), S AJ Haulcy (ankle), TE Ogletree (neck). Jones fully healthy.

sections.offseason:
**Bills:** McDermott fired; Joe Brady HC (Carmichael runs offense; Leonhard DC, 3-4). Traded 2nd to CHI for WR DJ Moore. Signed CB Alford, OLB Chubb, S Gardner-Johnson, LB Shaq Thompson; re-signed McGovern, Knox. Drafted EDGE T.J. Parker (35). No fullback for first time in Allen's career. Preseason 3-0.
**Texans:** Ryans/Caley/Burke continuity. Traded for RB David Montgomery; released Mixon; Kirk left for SF. Signed S Blankenship, OL Braden Smith (now IR), Trent Brown, Teller, Evan Brown, DE Clowney, TE Moreau. Drafted G Rutledge (26), DT McDonald (36), TE Klein (59). Stroud unextended (3,041/19 TD in 2025). Preseason 0-3.
